title: Veo 3.1 Prompt Engineering Templates
description: AI 비디오 생성을 위한 프롬프트 템플릿 및 가이드라인

components.name: subject
components.example: A young woman in a flowing red dress

components.name: action
components.example: walks slowly through a misty forest

components.name: setting
components.example: in an ancient bamboo forest at dawn

components.name: lighting
components.example: soft golden light filtering through leaves

cinematic_portrait.structure: [Character description] [subtle action] in [location], [shot type], [lighting style], cinematic color grading, [mood]
cinematic_portrait.example: A contemplative elderly man with weathered hands holds an antique pocket watch in a dimly lit study, close-up shot, warm candlelight casting deep shadows, muted earth tones, melancholic atmosphere

action_sequence.example: A parkour athlete leaps between rooftops in a neon-lit cyberpunk city at night, dynamic tracking shot, dramatic backlighting from holographic billboards, adrenaline-fueled intensity

landscape_mood.example: Sweeping aerial view of a volcanic coastline at sunrise with dramatic clouds, slow crane up, golden hour light reflecting on black sand beaches, epic scale, Terrence Malick inspired

intimate_moment.structure: [Characters] [intimate interaction] in [private space], [tight framing], [soft lighting], [emotional tone]
intimate_moment.example: Two dancers share a tender embrace in an empty rehearsal studio, intimate two-shot, soft window light, gentle movement, bittersweet longing

best_practices.good: worn leather jacket with brass buttons
slowly turns to face the camera
low angle tracking shot rising to eye level
morning mist, dust particles catching light
